# gitlab — 2022 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 219 gitlab CVEs of 2022 are in `data/cve/vendors/gitlab/2022.jsonl`.

### CVE-2022-0154
- Assigner: GitLab | Published: 2022-01-18 | Updated: 2024-08-02 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: Cross-site request forgery (csrf) in GitLab
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`

An issue has been discovered in GitLab affecting all versions starting from 7.7 before 14.4.5, all versions starting from 14.5.0 before 14.5.3, all versions starting from 14.6.0 before 14.6.2. GitLab was vulnerable to a Cross-Site Request Forgery attack that allows a malicious user to have their GitHub project imported on another GitLab user account.

Affected:
- GitLab / GitLab: affected >=7.7, <14.4.5; affected >=14.5.0, <14.5.3; affected >=14.6.0, <14.6.2

Credits: Thanks @aryan2808 for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program

References:
- https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/29580 [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://hackerone.com/reports/605576 [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cves/-/blob/master/2022/CVE-2022-0154.json [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.7 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:N/I:N/A:H`

- CWE: Use of hard-coded credentials in GitLab
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.1 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N`

### CVE-2022-1680
- Assigner: GitLab | Published: 2022-06-06 | Updated: 2024-08-03 | Max CVSS: 9.9
- CWE: Improper authorization in GitLab
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.9 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`

An account takeover issue has been discovered in GitLab EE affecting all versions starting from 11.10 before 14.9.5, all versions starting from 14.10 before 14.10.4, all versions starting from 15.0 before 15.0.1. When group SAML SSO is configured, the SCIM feature (available only on Premium+ subscriptions) may allow any owner of a Premium group to invite arbitrary users through their username and email, then change those users' email addresses via SCIM to an attacker controlled email address and thus - in the absence of 2FA - take over those accounts. It is also possible for the attacker to change the display name and username of the targeted account.

Affected:
- GitLab / GitLab: affected >=15.0.0, <15.0.1; affected >=14.10.0, <14.10.4; affected >=11.0, <14.9.5

Credits: This vulnerability has been discovered internally by the GitLab team

References:
- https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/363058 [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cves/-/blob/master/2022/CVE-2022-1680.json [x_refsource_CONFIRM]
